definitions.recoverable: true when every setting that determines the scores (revision, precision, library versions, recipe, truncation) is recorded or pinned, so the run can be repeated on the same weights; false for vendor APIs and for local runs that recorded no revision
definitions.pinning: full / partial (recipe recorded, weights or versions not) / none
definitions.inferred: circumstantial evidence for an unrecorded setting; never a record
definitions.precision: the dtype the weights ran in. transformers 5.x loads with dtype='auto' when none is given, so a CrossEncoder without a dtype runs in the checkpoint's declared dtype (bf16 for jina-reranker-v2-base-multilingual), not necessarily fp32
